name: Prisma MCP
tagline: Inspect, migrate, and query Prisma databases from chat.
shortDescription: The official Prisma MCP server. Inspect your schema, run migrations, execute queries, generate Prisma Client, and debug connection issues — all from your AI agent.
longDescription:
## What it is

The Prisma MCP server, by the Prisma team. Exposes the Prisma CLI and query engine as MCP tools: introspect schema, run `prisma migrate`, generate Prisma Client, execute raw queries, format schema files, and validate.

## Why we recommend it

Prisma users run into the same problems repeatedly: forgotten migrations, drift between schema and DB, slow queries. The MCP server makes those problems conversational — your agent can run `migrate status` and tell you what's pending without you ever opening a terminal.

## When to use it

- Schema work: agent edits `schema.prisma`, runs `prisma format`, runs `migrate dev`
- Drift detection: agent compares the DB schema to the Prisma schema
- Query help: agent writes a query, tests it, and tells you the result
- Migrations: agent runs `migrate deploy` and reports status
installInstructions:
1. Install Prisma in your project: `npm i prisma`
2. Set `DATABASE_URL` to your database connection string
3. `npx -y @prisma/mcp`

**Security note:** This server can run migrations. Use a read-only DB connection for safe exploration.
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Prisma ORM is open source. Prisma Accelerate (managed connection pool) has a free tier.
